feature_contract.goal: Avoid redundant D3D9 SetViewport submissions on every full-target world and HUD stereo draw while retaining exact original viewport/depth behavior on error or Reset.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R32 state restore and R33 FastWorld/HUD render paths plus verifier and CI; never modify FFB, DX11, frozen DXVK, SkyGlow or menu/HUD coordinates.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R32 right-pass restoration always issues SetRenderTarget(savedRt) then SetViewport(savedViewport) per successful R33 world/HUD stereo draw, although D3D9 SetRenderTarget resets to full viewport; R33 already elides same redundant call for right eye. Up to 3298 source draws per dense Quest3 frame in previous traces; FPS improvement unmeasured.
trace_stages: OutRun source original game RT0/viewport and left-eye draw establishes tracked state.
R33 FastWorld and HUD right-eye replay follow saved RT0 and extent-generation decision, separately from right-eye target.
R32 restore rebinds left RT0 then conditionally skips redundant SetViewport only on successful full-target bind; failure/recovery preserves explicit restoration.
subcomponents: Add separate borrowed game RT0 extent cache with Reset/rollback invalidation and reliable StateBlock gating for both stereo world and HUD callers.
Ensure successful RT0 bind is a precondition for skipping SetViewport and retain fallback for changed/inset/unknown/depth range, preserving all WVP and depth restoration.
Integrate seeded 4:3/16:9/21:9/Quest3 regression, destructive guard and same-SHA full Windows host/game/package/domain/impact CI.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: World and HUD stereo replay skip a redundant SetViewport only after proven successful full-viewport original RT0 rebinding.
Failed bind, unreliable tracking, inset or Z-range viewport, changed surface dimensions and device Reset retain explicit original viewport restoration.
Targeted deterministic regression and mutation guard and complete exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact are successful.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R32RestoreRightPassState unconditionally called device->SetViewport after binding savedRt on every R33 FastWorld and Hud stereo draw; D3D9 RT0 successful bind already resets full viewport.
diagnosis.root_cause: The pre-existing right-eye viewport full-target optimization lacked a symmetric original RT0 restore case, causing redundant driver state calls in each stereo primitive.
source_trace: D3D9 original game viewport and RT0 from R33 left-eye Draw.
R33 FastWorld/HUD right-eye replay and original target extent matched against generation-scoped cache.
R32 RestoreRightPassState original RT0 and depth/WVP restore after right Draw.
alternatives_rejected: Do not optimize by forcing full viewport on an inset or non-default depth range.
Never cache saved surface identity across device Reset or use unknown StateBlock state.
Do not reduce HMD quality or world/HUD stereo renders to fake performance gains.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Exact-SHA Windows policy PASS: 4 aspect/eye resolutions and failure/Reset/partial/Z-range/StateBlock negative cases, original right-eye mutations and existing depthless path regression.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Separate generation-scoped saved RT0 dimension lease and guarded R32 success-bound skip.

performance_evidence: One SetViewport driver state submission removed for each full-target stereo world/HUD draw with no projection quality change; HMD frame-time benefit not measured.

full_source_impact.note: Validation-bearing SHA changes only the same-task Python verifier; R32/R33 C++ and API material identical.

material.description: R33 saved original RT0 viewport lease and success-bound R32 viewport restore elision for world/HUD Draw

validation_evidence.targeted: New R33 source/negative mutation+4-resolution viewport model and R32 depthless regression PASS in exact-SHA Windows policy gate
validation_evidence.runtime: Quest3/VDXR actual game and frame-time untested.
